implementation.separableMcu: Reuse an18x18 packed RGB tile for Q6 matrix samples, then signed16-bit horizontal Q7 rows. Each distinct matrix input and horizontal row is computed once. Vertical filtering preserves all original phases, weights and rounding. Temporary32-byte horizontal results prevent overwriting tiny/repeated edge inputs.
implementation.normalization: Normalize directly to packed RGB with SSE2 or scalar fallback, preserving exact alpha/background and source/caller16-bit behavior. No full-frame intermediate.
implementation.quantization: Exact AVX2 sixteen-coefficient/SSE2 eight-coefficient unsigned high products, with signed magnitudes/sign restoration and independent DC rounding. The prepared plan shrinks from512 to256 stack bytes; scalar fallback remains.
implementation.resource: Same8-KiB fixed owner,54-byte caller row, table owners and262144work/MCU. No new per-operation heap allocation or admission fallback; borrowed root/input, cancellation and independent output lifetimes preserved.

qualification.exhaustiveQuantization: Every signed16-bit coefficient at every8-bit quantization step, including -32768 and rounding thresholds, normal/SSE2/scalar. Existing166 forward-transform vectors retained.
qualification.exhaustiveNormalization: All16777216 source/alpha/background combinations per channel; seven unaligned/tail/opaque controls, including the paired two-pixel tail.
qualification.geometry: Every legal1..65535 axis length has its monotone Q16 phase bound checked, with first/middle/last196605 actual MCU extents.18x18 fixed capacity; no image corpus/grid added.

signedCornerControls.sourceProvenance: Original1x1 yellow and2x2 cyan pixels; signed horizontal Cb/Cr Q7 guard and odd/even tiny-row reuse. Existing qscale5/optimal420 settings; no new performance profile.

diagnostics: Original513x259 and existing18x19 paired sources validated in-place Q6 reuse before production adoption. Initial matrix-only screen saved about4%; horizontal-row reuse about8%. Coarse section counters showed quantization about16% of the instrumented subtotal, motivating a whole vector kernel rather than further division tuning. Diagnostics are not independent timing claims; counters were removed before accepted builds.
